exposure: Preoperative MRI findings (uterus position, defect length, defect width, residual muscle layer thickness, adjacent uterine muscle layer thickness, distance from the defect to the external cervical os)
outcome: Clinical cure rate of abnormal uterine bleeding after laparoscopic surgery
cohort: 57 women who underwent laparoscopic surgery for previous cesarean scar defect-related abnormal uterine bleeding.
finding: The time of onset of abnormal uterine bleeding symptoms and the depth of the defect on preoperative MRI were identified as risk factors affecting the clinical cure rate of laparoscopic surgery for previous cesarean scar defect-related abnormal uterine bleeding.
